blocks.zh: 附錄四：技術轉移的工程考量事項
blocks.en: Appendix 4: Engineering Considerations in Technology Transfer

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解工程知識在技術轉移中的角色：為何設備、公用系統與自動化控制的差異會直接影響轉移成敗
blocks.en: Understand the role of engineering knowledge in technology transfer: why differences in equipment, utilities, and automated controls directly affect the success of a transfer

blocks.zh: 掌握三種設備轉移情境的差異，並能針對各情境制定對應的知識轉移策略
blocks.en: Grasp the differences among the three equipment transfer scenarios and be able to define a suitable knowledge transfer strategy for each

blocks.zh: 從六個實際案例中，辨識常見工程陷阱（磨耗、儀器漂移、設備優先級分歧、自動化配方錯誤等）
blocks.en: Recognize common engineering pitfalls (wear, instrument drift, divergent equipment priorities, automation recipe errors, etc.) from six real-world examples

blocks.zh: 學習四種有效的工程知識擷取技術：採購規劃、資料庫審查、RACI矩陣、工程等效性評估
blocks.en: Learn four effective engineering knowledge capture techniques: procurement planning, database review, RACI matrix, and engineering equivalence assessment

blocks.zh: 以CDMO接收產品的角度，建立工程就緒度（Engineering Readiness）查核思維
blocks.en: Build an engineering readiness checking mindset from the perspective of a CDMO receiving a product

blocks.zh: 11.1 Introduction — Engineering Knowledge in Technology Transfer 11.1 簡介 — 技術轉移中的工程知識
blocks.en: 11.1 Introduction — Engineering Knowledge in Technology Transfer

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 工程知識的雙向性
blocks.en: Core Concept — The Two-Way Nature of Engineering Knowledge

blocks.zh: 工程知識 (Engineering Knowledge) 在技術轉移中不只是「送出方教，接收方學」的單向流動。本章強調「持續雙向交流」，因為接收端在執行過程中往往會發現送出端從未遇過的問題，這些新發現若能回饋，將使整個組織受益。
blocks.en: Engineering knowledge in technology transfer is not a one-way flow of "the sending unit teaches, the receiving unit learns." This chapter stresses "continuous two-way exchange," because during execution the receiving site often finds problems the sending site has never encountered, and if these new findings are fed back, the whole organization benefits.

blocks.zh: GEP (Good Engineering Practice，良好工程規範) 是相對於 GxP 的工程端規範，涵蓋設備設計、建造、維護等最佳實踐，並非法規強制，但構成 GxP 驗證的基礎。
blocks.en: GEP (Good Engineering Practice) is the engineering-side counterpart to GxP. It covers best practices in equipment design, construction, and maintenance. It is not mandated by regulation, but it forms the foundation of GxP validation.

blocks.zh: 隱性知識 (Tacit Knowledge) 是本章的核心警示：許多關鍵工程經驗存在於工程師的腦袋、非正式紀錄或舊版操作手冊中，無法從驗證報告中讀取。轉移時最容易漏失的，就是這類知識。
blocks.en: Tacit knowledge is the key warning of this chapter: much critical engineering experience lives in engineers' heads, informal records, or old versions of operating manuals, and cannot be read from validation reports. This is the kind of knowledge most easily lost during transfer.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 搬家與裝修
blocks.en: Analogy — Moving House and Renovating

blocks.zh: 技術轉移的工程面，就像把一家米其林餐廳搬到新址：
blocks.en: The engineering side of technology transfer is like moving a Michelin-starred restaurant to a new location:

blocks.zh: 菜單（製程）可以帶走
blocks.en: The menu (process) can be taken along

blocks.zh: 設備（廚具）可以搬遷或重新採購
blocks.en: The equipment (kitchen tools) can be relocated or bought anew

blocks.zh: 但主廚對那台老烤箱「知道要調低10度」的經驗，是寫不進食譜的——這就是隱性工程知識
blocks.en: But the chef's experience that "this old oven needs to be set 10 degrees lower" cannot be written into a recipe. That is tacit engineering knowledge.

blocks.zh: 三種設備情境就像：(1) 把原本的烤箱搬過去、(2) 買一台同款烤箱、(3) 買一台不同品牌但功能相近的烤箱——越往後，需要重新摸索的東西越多。
blocks.en: The three equipment scenarios are like: (1) moving the original oven over, (2) buying the same model of oven, (3) buying an oven of a different brand with similar functions. The further along this list you go, the more has to be worked out again from scratch.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — Engineering Controls 與 CPP 的連結
blocks.en: Key Point — Linking Engineering Controls to CPPs

blocks.zh: 文件強調：工程控制是維持 CPP（關鍵製程參數）的關鍵手段。這意味著：
blocks.en: The document stresses that engineering controls are the key means of maintaining CPPs (critical process parameters). This means:

blocks.zh: 混合槽的攪拌轉速控制 → 維持混合均勻性 CPP
blocks.en: Agitation speed control of a mixing tank → maintains the blend uniformity CPP

blocks.zh: 溫控系統的精度 → 維持反應溫度 CPP
blocks.en: Accuracy of the temperature control system → maintains the reaction temperature CPP

blocks.zh: 材質規格（不鏽鋼等級、表面粗糙度）→ 維持清潔可靠性
blocks.en: Material specifications (stainless steel grade, surface roughness) → maintain cleaning reliability

blocks.zh: 因此，工程規格不是「硬體採購」問題，而是直接影響產品 CQA 的製程控制問題。轉移計畫必須讓工程團隊了解哪些 CPP 與工程設定直接掛鉤。
blocks.en: Engineering specifications are therefore not a "hardware purchasing" issue but a process control issue that directly affects product CQAs. The transfer plan must ensure the engineering team understands which CPPs are directly tied to which engineering settings.

blocks.zh: 三種設備情境的風險評分框架
blocks.en: Risk Scoring Framework for the Three Equipment Scenarios

blocks.zh:
情境 1：移轉相同設備
  風險等級：低
  重點：操作行為與產品接觸面歷史
  轉移文件：操作 SOP、維護紀錄、服務歷史

情境 2：各站各有同款設備
  風險等級：中
  重點：設定差異、校正頻率、使用慣例
  轉移文件：組態清單、標準校正計畫

情境 3：不同款設備（功能等效）
  風險等級：高
  重點：製程輸出等效性、重新驗證需求
  轉移文件：等效性評估報告、額外 PPQ 批次
blocks.en:
Scenario 1: Relocating identical equipment
  Risk level: Low
  Focus: Operating behavior and product-contact surface history
  Transfer documents: Operating SOPs, maintenance records, service history

Scenario 2: Same model of equipment at each site
  Risk level: Medium
  Focus: Setting differences, calibration frequency, usage practices
  Transfer documents: Configuration list, standard calibration plan

Scenario 3: Different equipment (functionally equivalent)
  Risk level: High
  Focus: Process output equivalence, revalidation needs
  Transfer documents: Equivalence assessment report, additional PPQ batches

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 接收工程就緒度初步評估
blocks.en: Practical Application — Initial Engineering Readiness Assessment for a Receiving CDMO

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO 接收方，在技術轉移計畫啟動時，工程團隊應提出以下問題：
blocks.en: As the receiving CDMO, when the technology transfer program starts, the engineering team should ask the following questions:

blocks.zh: 送出方使用的關鍵設備型號為何？我們的設備屬於哪一種情境？
blocks.en: Which models of critical equipment does the sending unit use? Which scenario does our equipment fall under?

blocks.zh: 哪些製程參數（CPP）直接由工程控制維持？我方設備的控制範圍是否覆蓋？
blocks.en: Which process parameters (CPPs) are maintained directly by engineering controls? Does the control range of our equipment cover them?

blocks.zh: 送出方是否有該設備的維護異常紀錄？有無因設備原因造成的偏差？
blocks.en: Does the sending unit have records of maintenance anomalies for this equipment? Have any deviations been caused by equipment?

blocks.zh: 自動化系統（SCADA/MES）的配方格式是否相容，還是需要重新程式化？
blocks.en: Are the recipe formats of the automation systems (SCADA/MES) compatible, or does reprogramming have to be done?

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 ISPE 說工程知識應該是「雙向」交流？接收端能貢獻什麼新知識給送出端？
blocks.en: Why does ISPE say engineering knowledge should be exchanged in "both directions"? What new knowledge can the receiving unit contribute to the sending unit?

blocks.zh: 隱性工程知識（Tacit Knowledge）有哪些常見形式？如何在轉移計畫中有效擷取它？
blocks.en: What are the common forms of tacit engineering knowledge? How can it be captured effectively in a transfer plan?

blocks.zh: 如果你的公司是 CDMO，接收一個新產品，你會如何判斷屬於情境 1、2 還是 3？各自的後續行動有何不同？
blocks.en: If your company is a CDMO receiving a new product, how would you decide whether it falls under Scenario 1, 2, or 3? How do the follow-up actions differ for each?

blocks.zh: 11.2 Examples — Real-World Engineering Failures in Technology Transfer 11.2 範例 — 技術轉移中的實際工程失敗案例
blocks.en: 11.2 Examples — Real-World Engineering Failures in Technology Transfer

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 六個案例的共同根源
blocks.en: Core Concept — The Common Root of the Six Examples

blocks.zh: 六個案例看似各不相同，但根本問題只有一個：「知道的人沒有說，需要知道的人沒有問」。
blocks.en: The six examples look different, but they share one root problem: "those who knew did not say, and those who needed to know did not ask."

blocks.zh: 案例1：機械磨耗知識停留在一個廠站，未建立知識回饋機制
blocks.en: Example 1: Knowledge about mechanical wear stayed at one site, and no knowledge feedback mechanism was established

blocks.zh: 案例2：儀器漂移的採購歷史知識沒有納入設備選型流程
blocks.en: Example 2: Procurement-history knowledge about instrument drift was not built into the equipment selection process

blocks.zh: 案例3：送出端與接收端各有一套設備維護優先級，沒有事先比較
blocks.en: Example 3: The sending and receiving sites each had their own equipment maintenance priorities, and these were not compared in advance

blocks.zh: 案例4：清潔驗證的工程試驗數據（不只是最終結論）沒有轉移
blocks.en: Example 4: The engineering trial data for cleaning validation (not just the final conclusions) was not transferred

blocks.zh: 案例5：接收端能力不足，但商業談判阻礙了技術支援
blocks.en: Example 5: The receiving site lacked capability, but commercial negotiations got in the way of technical support

blocks.zh: 案例6：「不換設備」等於「不需要委試」的假設，造成自動化配方疏漏
blocks.en: Example 6: The assumption that "not changing equipment" means "no commissioning needed" led to automation recipe oversights

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 案例1：汽車保養知識的「孤島效應」
blocks.en: Analogy — Example 1: The "Island Effect" in Car Maintenance Knowledge

blocks.zh: 你有三台同款汽車分別在三個城市。其中一台的車主發現「每行駛8萬公里後離合器片需特別潤滑」，他自己處理好了，但沒有告訴其他兩位車主——因為沒有人問他。另外兩台車最終離合器故障。這就是案例1的本質：知識存在，但沒有觸發分享的機制。
blocks.en: Suppose you have three identical cars in three different cities. The owner of one finds that "the clutch plate needs special lubrication every 80,000 km," and handles it himself, but does not tell the other two owners, because nobody asked him. The other two cars eventually suffer clutch failure. This is the essence of Example 1: the knowledge exists, but there is no mechanism to trigger sharing.

blocks.zh: 技術轉移計畫必須內建「知識回饋環路」（Feedback Loop），讓接收端的新發現能自動回流到組織知識庫。
blocks.en: A technology transfer program must have a built-in "feedback loop" so that new findings at the receiving site automatically flow back into the organization's knowledge base.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 案例6：最危險的假設
blocks.en: Key Point — Example 6: The Most Dangerous Assumption

blocks.zh: 「既有設備，不需要重新委試（Commissioning）」——這是技術轉移中最危險的假設之一。
blocks.en: "The equipment already exists, so it does not need to be re-commissioned" is one of the most dangerous assumptions in technology transfer.

blocks.zh: 當設備已存在，但需要被重新配置以承接新製程時，自動化配方（Recipe）、控制邏輯、參數設定都需要重新驗證。案例6中的接收端以為「設備沒換，所以配方套用就好」，結果在第一批生產批次就失敗。
blocks.en: When existing equipment must be reconfigured to take on a new process, the automation recipe, control logic, and parameter settings all need to be revalidated. In Example 6, the receiving site assumed that "the equipment is unchanged, so we can just apply the recipe," and the very first production batch failed.

blocks.zh: CDMO 規則：只要製程新增、設備重新配置，就必須進行系統性的配方驗證，即使設備是既有的。
blocks.en: CDMO rule: whenever a process is added or equipment is reconfigured, systematic recipe verification must be performed, even if the equipment is existing.

blocks.zh: 案例4 — 清潔驗證工程數據轉移的最低要求
blocks.en: Example 4 — Minimum Requirements for Transferring Cleaning Validation Engineering Data

blocks.zh:
清潔驗證轉移包（最低要求）：
  A. 最終驗證報告（含接受標準）
  B. 工程試驗數據（含失敗的試驗！）
  C. 清潔劑濃度、溫度、時間參數的開發歷程
  D. 設備幾何差異評估（送出 vs. 接收端）
  E. 承包商聯絡方式與試驗環境描述

注意：僅轉移 A 項是不夠的。
接收端在遇到問題時，需要 B+C 來理解
「為什麼接受標準這樣設」。
blocks.en:
Cleaning validation transfer package (minimum requirements):
  A. Final validation report (including acceptance criteria)
  B. Engineering trial data (including failed trials!)
  C. Development history of detergent concentration, temperature, and time parameters
  D. Assessment of equipment geometry differences (sending vs. receiving site)
  E. Contractor contact details and description of the trial environment

Note: Transferring item A alone is not enough.
When problems arise, the receiving site needs B + C to understand
"why the acceptance criteria were set this way."

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 案例5：CDMO 能力評估的商業現實
blocks.en: Key Point — Example 5: The Commercial Reality of CDMO Capability Assessment

blocks.zh: 案例5揭示了一個常見的商業困境：送出端判斷接收端需要工程支援，但接收端（CMO）拒絕承擔費用。結果是三個月延誤，商業罰款條款幾乎被啟動。
blocks.en: Example 5 reveals a common commercial dilemma: the sending unit judged that the receiving unit (CMO) needed engineering support, but the receiving unit refused to bear the cost. The result was a three-month delay, and the commercial penalty clause was almost triggered.

blocks.zh: 教訓：在技術轉移合約中，必須明確規定工程支援的責任歸屬與費用分擔，不能依賴「口頭善意」。接收端能力評估（Capability Assessment）應在合約簽訂前完成，並將技術支援需求列入合約條款。
blocks.en: Lesson: A technology transfer contract must explicitly define responsibility for engineering support and how costs are shared; it cannot rely on "verbal goodwill." The capability assessment of the receiving unit should be completed before the contract is signed, and technical support needs should be written into the contract terms.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 工程就緒度查核清單（12項）
blocks.en: Practical Application — CDMO Engineering Readiness Checklist (12 Items)

blocks.zh: 關鍵設備的資格狀態（IQ/OQ/PQ）是否有效？
blocks.en: Is the qualification status (IQ/OQ/PQ) of critical equipment valid?

blocks.zh: 公用系統容量（WFI、潔淨蒸汽、壓縮空氣、冰水）是否已確認足夠？
blocks.en: Has utility capacity (WFI, clean steam, compressed air, chilled water) been confirmed as sufficient?

blocks.zh: 環境分類是否符合製程要求（ISO 5/7/8）？
blocks.en: Does the environmental classification meet process requirements (ISO 5/7/8)?

blocks.zh: 自動化配方是否已從送出端映射並驗證？
blocks.en: Have the automation recipes been mapped from the sending site and verified?

blocks.zh: 儀器校正狀態與頻率是否符合 CPP 精度需求？
blocks.en: Do instrument calibration status and frequency meet the accuracy requirements of the CPPs?

blocks.zh: 材質規格（材質相容性、表面粗糙度）是否與送出端一致？
blocks.en: Are material specifications (material compatibility, surface roughness) consistent with the sending site?

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證數據包（含工程試驗數據）是否完整接收？
blocks.en: Has the cleaning validation data package (including engineering trial data) been received in full?

blocks.zh: 維護優先級分類是否與送出端比較並達成共識？
blocks.en: Has the maintenance priority classification been compared with the sending site and agreed?

blocks.zh: 設備服務歷史是否已審查，有無重複性偏差？
blocks.en: Has the equipment service history been reviewed, and are there any recurring deviations?

blocks.zh: 知識回饋機制是否已建立（接收端發現問題，如何回報給送出端？）？
blocks.en: Has a knowledge feedback mechanism been established (how does the receiving site report problems it finds back to the sending site)?

blocks.zh: 第三方供應商/廠商的支援能力在接收端地區是否已確認？
blocks.en: Has the support capability of third-party suppliers/vendors been confirmed in the receiving site's region?

blocks.zh: 工程等效性評估（送出 vs. 接收端設備）是否已完成文件化？
blocks.en: Has the engineering equivalence assessment (sending vs. receiving site equipment) been completed and documented?

blocks.zh: 案例2中，Site 3 基於先前儀器漂移的壞經驗選擇了不同品牌的儀器。這個「教訓」為什麼沒有被傳遞給 Site 1 和 2？組織應建立什麼機制來防止這種情況？
blocks.en: In Example 2, Site 3 chose a different brand of instrument based on bad prior experience with instrument drift. Why was this "lesson" not passed on to Sites 1 and 2? What mechanism should an organization establish to prevent this?

blocks.zh: 案例4中，「只轉移驗證結論、不轉移工程試驗過程」的風險是什麼？在你的組織中，有哪些類似的知識轉移缺口？
blocks.en: In Example 4, what are the risks of "transferring only the validation conclusions and not the engineering trial process"? What similar knowledge transfer gaps exist in your organization?

blocks.zh: 案例6告訴我們，「不換設備」不等於「不需要驗證」。請列舉三種「設備未變但配置改變」的情境，每種情境需要的驗證活動為何？
blocks.en: Example 6 tells us that "not changing equipment" does not mean "no validation needed." List three scenarios in which the equipment is unchanged but the configuration changes, and state the validation activities each requires.

blocks.zh: 11.3 Lessons Learned — Techniques for Capturing Engineering Information 11.3 經驗教訓 — 工程資訊擷取技術
blocks.en: 11.3 Lessons Learned — Techniques for Capturing Engineering Information

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 五種工程知識擷取技術
blocks.en: Core Concept — Five Techniques for Capturing Engineering Knowledge

blocks.zh: ISPE 提出的五種工具，各有其應用時機：
blocks.en: ISPE proposes five tools, each with its own time of application:

blocks.zh: 採購規劃：在設備採購時就開始規劃知識轉移——這是最省力的時機，因為工程師還在現場
blocks.en: Procurement planning: plan knowledge transfer as early as equipment procurement. This is the lowest-effort moment, because the engineers are still on site.

blocks.zh: 工程資料庫審查：系統性地挖掘 CMMS、校正紀錄、組態管理系統中的隱性知識
blocks.en: Engineering database review: systematically mine tacit knowledge from the CMMS, calibration records, and configuration management systems

blocks.zh: RACI 矩陣：明確分工——誰負責（Responsible）、誰當責（Accountable）、誰諮詢（Consulted）、誰知情（Informed）
blocks.en: RACI matrix: clearly assign roles: who is Responsible, who is Accountable, who is Consulted, and who is Informed

blocks.zh: 工程等效性評估：即使型號相同，也要比較實際效能數據，不能假設「相同型號 = 相同效能」
blocks.en: Engineering equivalence assessment: even when the model is the same, compare actual performance data; do not assume "same model = same performance"

blocks.zh: 持續比較基準：轉移後的持續監測，讓雙方都能從比較中學習
blocks.en: Ongoing benchmarking: continued monitoring after transfer, so that both parties can learn from the comparison

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — RACI 矩陣：工程版的「婚禮協調人」
blocks.en: Analogy — The RACI Matrix: The Engineering "Wedding Coordinator"

blocks.zh: 大型婚禮需要一個協調人來確保：新郎新娘（Accountable）、婚禮規劃師（Responsible for logistics）、雙方家長（Consulted on preferences）、賓客（Informed of schedule）各司其職。
blocks.en: A large wedding needs a coordinator to make sure everyone does their part: the bride and groom (Accountable), the wedding planner (Responsible for logistics), the parents of both families (Consulted on preferences), and the guests (Informed of the schedule).

blocks.zh: 技術轉移的工程 RACI 矩陣扮演同樣角色：清楚定義「這個設備的校正計畫由誰主責？送出端要諮詢哪些事項？」否則在跨國、跨公司的轉移中，每個人都以為另一個人在處理，最後沒有人處理。
blocks.en: The engineering RACI matrix in a technology transfer plays the same role: it clearly defines "who leads the calibration program for this equipment? What must the sending unit be consulted on?" Otherwise, in a cross-border, cross-company transfer, everyone assumes someone else is handling it, and in the end nobody does.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 工程等效性評估的真正意涵
blocks.en: Key Point — What Engineering Equivalence Assessment Really Means

blocks.zh: 「工程等效性 (Engineering Equivalence)」在法規層面與技術層面有不同含義：
blocks.en: "Engineering equivalence" has different meanings at the regulatory level and the technical level:

blocks.zh: 技術等效：設備能執行相同功能，在關鍵參數範圍內達到相同輸出——可以透過工程比較數據証明
blocks.en: Technical equivalence: the equipment can perform the same function and achieve the same output within the critical parameter ranges, which can be demonstrated through engineering comparison data

blocks.zh: 法規等效：若設備類型不同（例如：從磁力攪拌換成機械攪拌），即使功能等效，法規上可能需要額外的 PPQ 批次數據，甚至變更通報
blocks.en: Regulatory equivalence: if the equipment type differs (for example, changing from magnetic stirring to mechanical agitation), even if the function is equivalent, additional PPQ batch data, or even a change notification, may be required by regulation

blocks.zh: CDMO 在接收新產品時，必須先完成等效性評估，再決定是否需要追加 PPQ 批次——這個決定要在 PPQ 執行前完成，不是在執行時發現問題再來討論。
blocks.en: When receiving a new product, the CDMO must complete the equivalence assessment first and then decide whether additional PPQ batches are needed. This decision must be made before PPQ execution, not discussed after problems are discovered during execution.

blocks.zh: 工程等效性評估框架（發送端 vs. 接收端）
blocks.en: Engineering Equivalence Assessment Framework (Sending vs. Receiving Site)

blocks.zh:
比較維度               發送端        接收端        差異風險
---------------------------------------------------------
設備型號/廠牌         XXX           YYY           高/中/低
製造日期/世代         2018          2023          低（較新）
攪拌類型              錨式          槳式          高→需重新確認Re數
溫控精度              ±0.5°C        ±1.0°C        中→需評估CPP容忍度
材質 (接觸面)         316L SS       316L SS       低
表面粗糙度 Ra         ≤0.8μm        ≤0.8μm        低
自動化平台            Siemens S7    Rockwell AB   高→配方需重新映射
校正頻率              每季           每半年        中→需評估儀器穩定性
CMMS系統              SAP-PM        Oracle-EAM    低（數據可轉換）
公用系統容量           足夠          待確認        -→必須在PPQ前確認
blocks.en:
Comparison dimension     Sending site  Receiving site  Difference risk
---------------------------------------------------------
Equipment model/brand    XXX           YYY             High/Medium/Low
Manufacture date/generation  2018      2023            Low (newer)
Agitator type            Anchor        Paddle          High → reconfirm Reynolds number
Temperature control accuracy  ±0.5°C  ±1.0°C          Medium → assess CPP tolerance
Material (contact surfaces)  316L SS   316L SS         Low
Surface roughness Ra     ≤0.8μm        ≤0.8μm          Low
Automation platform      Siemens S7    Rockwell AB     High → recipes must be remapped
Calibration frequency    Quarterly     Semiannual      Medium → assess instrument stability
CMMS system              SAP-PM        Oracle-EAM      Low (data convertible)
Utility capacity         Sufficient    To be confirmed -→ must be confirmed before PPQ

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 工程 SME 面對面會議議程（推薦實踐）
blocks.en: Practical Application — Agenda for the CDMO Engineering SME Face-to-Face Meeting (Recommended Practice)

blocks.zh: 根據 ISPE 建議，工程 SME 的首次面對面會議應涵蓋：
blocks.en: Per ISPE recommendations, the first face-to-face meeting of the engineering SMEs should cover:

blocks.zh: 製程概覽：送出端介紹製程中的關鍵工程控制點（30分鐘）
blocks.en: Process overview: the sending unit presents the critical engineering control points in the process (30 minutes)

blocks.zh: 設備比較：逐一比較關鍵設備，完成初步等效性評分（60分鐘）
blocks.en: Equipment comparison: compare critical equipment item by item and complete a preliminary equivalence scoring (60 minutes)

blocks.zh: 已知問題盤點：送出端坦誠分享設備的已知缺陷、磨耗模式、重複偏差（30分鐘）
blocks.en: Known issues inventory: the sending unit openly shares known equipment defects, wear patterns, and recurring deviations (30 minutes)

blocks.zh: 自動化配方審查：映射關鍵配方參數到接收端控制系統（45分鐘）
blocks.en: Automation recipe review: map the critical recipe parameters to the receiving site's control system (45 minutes)

blocks.zh: 能力差距識別：接收端工程師說明自身的技術強項與弱項（30分鐘）
blocks.en: Capability gap identification: the receiving site's engineers describe their own technical strengths and weaknesses (30 minutes)

blocks.zh: RACI 草稿：共同起草分工矩陣，明確各類文件的交付責任（30分鐘）
blocks.en: Draft RACI: jointly draft the responsibility matrix, clarifying delivery responsibility for each type of document (30 minutes)

blocks.zh: 這個會議應在技術轉移計畫正式啟動後的第一個月內完成。
blocks.en: This meeting should be completed within the first month after the technology transfer program formally starts.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 公用系統容量要在 PPQ 前確認
blocks.en: Key Point — Confirm Utility Capacity Before PPQ

blocks.zh: 文章特別強調，接收端必須在技術轉移執行前（而非 PPQ 期間）確認公用系統容量：
blocks.en: The document particularly stresses that the receiving site must confirm utility capacity before technology transfer execution (not during PPQ):

blocks.zh: WFI：用水量、生產高峰時段的流量需求
blocks.en: WFI: water consumption and flow demand during peak production periods

blocks.zh: 潔淨蒸汽：SIP 需求與用量
blocks.en: Clean steam: SIP requirements and consumption

blocks.zh: 壓縮空氣：品質（露點）與流量
blocks.en: Compressed air: quality (dew point) and flow

blocks.zh: 冰水系統：製程冷卻需求
blocks.en: Chilled water system: process cooling demand

blocks.zh: 這些往往在 PPQ 執行時才發現不足，但此時已太晚——修改工程需要數週，而 PPQ 批次的窗口可能已被佔用。公用系統容量確認是工程就緒度查核清單的必要項目。
blocks.en: Shortfalls in these are often discovered only during PPQ execution, but by then it is too late: engineering modifications take weeks, and the window for the PPQ batches may already be taken. Confirming utility capacity is a mandatory item on the engineering readiness checklist.

blocks.zh: CMMS（電腦化維護管理系統）中有哪些類型的數據，對技術轉移最具價值？為什麼「歷史校正紀錄」比「當前校正計畫」更重要？
blocks.en: What types of data in the CMMS (computerized maintenance management system) are most valuable for technology transfer? Why is "historical calibration records" more important than the "current calibration schedule"?

blocks.zh: ISPE 建議在採購時就開始規劃技術轉移知識擷取。在你的組織中，設備採購與技術轉移規劃通常是否整合？如果沒有，整合的主要障礙是什麼？
blocks.en: ISPE recommends starting knowledge capture planning for technology transfer at the time of procurement. In your organization, are equipment procurement and technology transfer planning usually integrated? If not, what are the main barriers to integration?

blocks.zh: 「持續比較基準（Ongoing Benchmarking）」對 CDMO 的業務有什麼長期價值？除了解決眼前問題，它如何幫助 CDMO 提升競爭力？
blocks.en: What long-term value does "Ongoing Benchmarking" have for a CDMO's business? Beyond solving the immediate problem, how does it help the CDMO improve its competitiveness?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 工程知識是技術轉移的隱形脊梁：製程文件可以被複製，但設備的磨耗模式、儀器的漂移行為、操作員的設定技巧，這些隱性知識才是轉移成敗的關鍵，必須主動規劃擷取。
blocks.en: Engineering knowledge is the invisible backbone of technology transfer: process documents can be copied, but equipment wear patterns, instrument drift behavior, and operators' setting techniques are the tacit knowledge that decides whether a transfer succeeds, and capturing it must be planned proactively.

blocks.zh: 六個案例的核心警示：機械磨耗需要知識回饋機制（#1）、儀器選型需要採購歷史（#2）、維護優先級需要事先比較（#3）、清潔驗證需要轉移工程試驗數據而非只有結論（#4）、接收端能力需要合約保障（#5）、「設備沒換」不等於「配方不需驗證」（#6）。
blocks.en: Core warnings from the six examples: mechanical wear needs a knowledge feedback mechanism (#1); instrument selection needs procurement history (#2); maintenance priorities need to be compared in advance (#3); cleaning validation requires transferring engineering trial data, not just conclusions (#4); receiving-site capability needs contractual safeguards (#5); and "the equipment did not change" does not mean "the recipe needs no verification" (#6).

blocks.zh: 自動化配方映射是高風險盲點：在不同控制系統平台之間轉移製程時，配方參數的逐一映射與驗證是必要步驟，不能假設「參數名稱相同就等於設定相同」。
blocks.en: Automation recipe mapping is a high-risk blind spot: when transferring a process between different control system platforms, item-by-item mapping and verification of recipe parameters is a necessary step; one cannot assume that "the same parameter name means the same setting."

blocks.zh: 五種工具的時機：採購期規劃（最早介入）→ 工程資料庫審查（轉移前）→ RACI 矩陣（計畫啟動後立即）→ 等效性評估（PPQ 前完成）→ 持續基準比較（轉移後長期）。
blocks.en: Timing of the five tools: procurement-stage planning (earliest involvement) → engineering database review (before transfer) → RACI matrix (immediately after program start) → equivalence assessment (completed before PPQ) → ongoing benchmarking (long term after transfer).

blocks.zh: CDMO 就緒度查核：公用系統容量、自動化配方、設備服務歷史、清潔驗證工程數據、維護優先級比較——這五項必須在 PPQ 執行前完成，晚了就是批次風險。
blocks.en: CDMO readiness check: utility capacity, automation recipes, equipment service history, cleaning validation engineering data, and maintenance priority comparison: these five items must be completed before PPQ execution; if late, they become batch risk.
